comparable_interval_rule: a cohort is only compared on rows every cohort in that comparison has. Guide L08.4 forbids attributing an improvement that comes from a short recent window to a feature group

complexity_ladder.question: does an explainable rule already separate the states a jump model finds?
complexity_ladder.expected_failure: M0 tracks volatility only and misses coordinated moves
complexity_ladder.stop_condition: if M0 resolves as much variance out of fold as M1, M1 is unjustified

complexity_ladder.question: does persistence-penalised clustering resolve out-of-fold variance?
complexity_ladder.expected_failure: states are volatility buckets with extra steps
complexity_ladder.stop_condition: if M1 does not beat M0 out of fold, the ladder stops here

complexity_ladder.question: with many blocks, does sparsity find the ones that matter?
complexity_ladder.expected_failure: with three blocks there is nothing to select
complexity_ladder.stop_condition: guide 8.1 scopes M1S to 'many blocks'; with 3 it is not attempted, and guide 8.3 forbids writing a naive sparse objective without a pinned research implementation

complexity_ladder.question: is the structure specific to a jump model or to the features?
complexity_ladder.expected_failure: a different family finds the same partition
complexity_ladder.stop_condition: guide 8.1 declines to make M2 mandatory and warns against sweeping model families; not attempted

ladder_rule: each rung states its question, its expected failure and its stop condition BEFORE it runs. A ladder without those is a sweep (guide L08.5)
tuning_stage: development only; K, lambda, training memory and cadence are never tuned against the outer window
